decisions.reason: The bio-based bitumen binder rests on the firm's own R&D in materials conversion but sits far from its plant-building core, which limits its ability to interpret market results and improve the product, so withdrawal risk is substantial even though its flagship status argues for keeping it one more year.

The infectious waste plant extends the modular WASTX platform and is co-developed with ERMAFA, so the firm has strong related knowledge and partner support to learn from early deployments and refine it.

The mobile mechanical recycling plant is a close extension of the core decentralized machinery and serves as a pretreatment stage for existing systems, so the firm can readily absorb customer feedback and improve it.
